why_this_rate: The rate every section here was read and scored at: the unit's output ends between sixteen and eighteen kilohertz, and a chain at thirty-two ends there.

map.why: The window the gain class closed on, taken as it stands rather than refitted here. What is being asked is the section and not the law on the byte, and a gain refitted per type would let a first-order shelf borrow a second-order one's steepness by claiming more decibels.

what_is_not_modelled: The enhancer path itself. Sens and Mix are fixed at power-on and carry no node: the one sweep of Sens on this unit was taken with Mix written to 00, so nothing measured bounds what the path adds, and a candidate for it would be a guess with no source to name.
